title: Fruza Mandarin Mango Freeze 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Mandarin Mango Freeze by Fruza delivers a vibrant and frosty tropical mix. This flavour pairs the juicy, sweet notes of ripe Mango with the sharp, zesty tang of Mandarin. A powerful cooling freeze effect rounds out the profile, making this a bold and invigorating fruit ice flavour. The Fruza shortfill range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg e-liquid. This leaves the perfect amount of space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 120ml of 3mg nicotine-strength e-liquid. All Fruza e-liquids are made in the UK, TPD-compliant, and feature a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
